title: Allowlist /free-games query parameters at the Worker edge and block repeated anonymous cache-busting

endpoints.before: All arbitrary query parameters (including cache-busters such as _=<timestamp>) were included in the Worker edge cache key and forwarded to origin without rate-limiting repeated cache-busting attempts.
endpoints.after: The Cloudflare Worker strips query parameters outside the /free-games allowlist (country, locale, expand) from both edge cache keys and upstream forwarding, and rejects repeated anonymous cache-busting requests (>3 per minute per IP) with HTTP 429 CACHE_BUSTER_DETECTED directing callers to remove unsupported parameters or create a free account at https://devs.egdata.app.
endpoints.clientAction: Remove unsupported query parameters (such as cache-busting timestamps) from /free-games requests, or create a free API key at https://devs.egdata.app and use /v1/free-games.
